The role leads security standards for open source software across the Ubuntu platform, including desktops, servers, edge devices, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and OpenStack.   • Strong academic track record from high school and university

  • Strong interest in software and application security
  • Experience in an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated continuous learning mindset
  • Ability to build trust and relationships, and to drive results

Canonical is a pioneering tech company and the publisher of Ubuntu. We recruit globally and uphold high standards, with a remote-first approach since 2004. We value excellence and continuous learning. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

About the project:

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer , you will own and optimize OpenTelemetry pipelines, enabling scalable and efficient observability. You’ll build tools that empower teams, support incident response, and drive best practices. Your work ensures a reliable, secure infrastructure and actionable alerting across the organization.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, and maintain observability pipelines across the three main signals—logs, metrics, and traces—ensuring standardized, scalable, and efficient data ingestion. Optimize ingestion strategies to balance cost, performance, and usability.

Build self-service automation and tooling that enables development teams to instrument and leverage observability without requiring manual intervention from the SRE team. Drive adoption of best practices while ensuring teams own their telemetry.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Interact with members from almost all teams across the business to understand their monitoring, alerting, and SLO / SLA requirements and design systems and processes that ensure we meet or exceed these requirements. Influence architectural decisions during initial design stages to ensure resiliency and scale at the outset of software development.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Design base-level requirements for new and existing services to ensure that all client infrastructure and code are monitored consistently and accurately at a basic level.

Take full ownership of client infrastructure reliability, ensuring adherence to key availability and security KPIs.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working as an SRE Engineer or in a very similar role, more focused on observability.

5+ Years of experience working with cloud (AWS).

5+ Years of experience working with IaC tools (Terraform) and GitOps CI/CD solutions (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).

4+ Years of experience working with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, New Relic, or Datadog (experience managing observability pipelines at scale in high-throughput environments).

4+ Years of experience working in Kubernetes, including its core components, deployment methodologies, and monitoring best practices.

Strong communication skills with team members and stakeholders (technical and nontechnical communication).

Strong scripting abilities (Python, Go, or similar) for automating observability tasks.

Experience integrating incident management platforms (PagerDuty, Jira) with automated alerting workflows.

title: Gerente de Performance de Negócio de Saúde
description:
Visão Geral

Somos a Conexa , ecossistema digital de saúde integral, líder na América Latina . Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

A Conexa está revolucionando o acesso à saúde e, para continuarmos crescendo de forma sustentável e eficiente, estamos em busca de uma liderança estratégica para a nossa área de Performance e Planejamento.

A sua missão será construir e liderar o processo de Planejamento Integrado de Saúde (S&OP), conectando as áreas de Growth, Operações Assistenciais, Negócios e Finanças. Você será a pessoa responsável por garantir que nossa capacidade de atendimento e nossa demanda de pacientes estejam perfeitamente equilibradas, otimizando a utilização de nossos recursos, reduzindo custos e, o mais importante, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos pacientes.

Se você é apaixonado por dados, obcecado por eficiência e tem experiência em construir processos de planejamento do zero, esta é a sua oportunidade de deixar uma marca profunda em uma empresa de alto crescimento.

Aviso importante!

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito . Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Você será responsável por:
  • • Estruturar e Liderar o Processo de S&OP: Desenhar e implementar o ciclo de planejamento integrado da companhia, definindo cadências (semanais, mensais, trimestrais), rituais e fóruns para tomada de decisão colaborativa entre as áreas.
  • • Gestão de Capacidade vs. Demanda: Analisar profundamente nossa capacidade médica (oferta) versus a previsão de demanda, identificando ociosidade, gargalos e oportunidades de otimização para garantir a máxima taxa de ocupação e o menor custo por consulta.
  • • Ownership do Forecast: Assumir a responsabilidade pelo processo de previsão de demanda, trabalhando em parceria com a área de Growth para medir, desafiar e calibrar os modelos, garantindo alta acurácia e visibilidade de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • • Fomentar a Cultura de Dados: Padronizar e governar os principais KPIs da operação (ex: taxa de ocupação, custo por consulta, no-show), desenvolvendo dashboards e relatórios que tragam transparência e embasem todas as decisões estratégicas.
  • • Análise de Custos e Interface com Finanças: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico do time Financeiro, analisando as variações de custo assistencial, apoiando a estruturação dos processos de pagamento e garantindo a saúde financeira da operação.
  • • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas de performance, transformando a área em um centro de excelência técnica e estratégica dentro da companhia.
Requisitos e competências
  • Esperamos de você:
  • • Sólida experiência em áreas de Planejamento (S&OP, IBP, FP&A), Business Intelligence ou Planejamento Estratégico.
  • • Experiência comprovada em liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • • Forte habilidade analítica e quantitativa, com domínio em ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similar).
  • • Experiência com modelagem de dados, forecasting e análise de cenários.
  • • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de influenciar líderes de diferentes áreas.
  • Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • • Experiência no setor de saúde, healthtechs ou empresas de tecnologia com operações complexas (marketplaces, logística etc.).
  • • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise de dados (Python ou R).
  • • Experiência em projetos de otimização de custos e eficiência operacional.
Informações adicionais
  • Benefícios Conexa:
  • • Cartão CAJU , crédito de R$ 1.059,00 ao mês distribuídos entre as categorias: Refeição, Alimentação, Mobilidade, Saúde, Home Office, Cultura e Educação;
  • • Plano de Saúde AMIL Nível Nacional S750R1 Especial Apto , com coparticipação de 30% sob consultas e exames e 40% PS; Extensível para dependentes Legais (cônjuges e/ou filhos até 24 anos) e os valores por dependente são descontados em Folha de Pagamento. Valor para o dependente: R$ 826,92 por vida + coparticipação.
  • • Acesso gratuito às plataformas Conexa e Zenklub , com consultas online para cuidar da sua saúde mental e física;
  • • Auxílio Creche de acordo com a convenção coletiva regional e Licença Maternidade Estendida para as mamães da nossa equipe: oferecemos a opção de estender a licença maternidade para 6 meses. Para os papais, a licença paternidade é de 30 dias.
  • • Seguro de Vida SULAMERICA : Sabe aquele ditado "viver sem medo"? Bem, é mais ou menos isso. Queremos que você se sinta seguro(a) sabendo que você e seus entes queridos estão protegidos, não importa o que aconteça.

description:
Overview

Job Description - Coordenador BIM (RIO00DP)

Construindo sobre nosso passado. Prontos para o futuro

A Worley é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais composta por especialistas em energia, produtos químicos e recursos. Estabelecemos parcerias com clientes para entregar projetos e criar valor ao longo da vida de seus ativos. Estamos a unir dois mundos, avançando em direção a fontes de energia mais sustentáveis, ao mesmo tempo que ajudamos a fornecer a energia, os produtos químicos e os recursos necessários agora.

Procuramos um Coordenador(a) BIM para liderar a implementação, gestão e padronização de processos BIM em projetos de engenharia Onshore, assegurando conformidade com normas e integração com sistemas corporativos e dos clientes.

O profissional será responsável por coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, gerir o fluxo de informações do projeto e garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas de Building Information Modeling para otimizar a qualidade e a eficiência na entrega dos empreendimentos.

Responsibilities
  • Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a execução da estratégia BIM em todas as fases do projeto.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas, padrões corporativos e diretrizes como ISO 19650 .
  • Definir e implementar o BEP (BIM Execution Plan) e outros documentos de gestão BIM.
  • Coordenar a integração entre modelos BIM de diferentes disciplinas (arquitetura, estrutura, instalações, processos industriais, etc.).
  • Validar modelos digitais, assegurando consistência, integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Promover integração entre plataformas BIM e sistemas corporativos (COMOS, AVEVA, Revit, Navisworks, entre outros).
  • Gerenciar revisões e controle de versões dos modelos digitais.
  • Treinar e dar suporte às equipes de projeto quanto às metodologias, ferramentas e fluxos BIM.
  • Apoiar clientes e stakeholders na interpretação e uso de informações geradas em ambiente BIM.
  • Participar ativamente na análise e proposição de melhorias nos processos digitais da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Formação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de projetos BIM em indústrias de grande porte (óleo & gás, energia, mineração, infraestrutura).
  • Experiência com gestão de modelos multidisciplinares e detecção de interferências (Clash Detection).
  • Conhecimento de normas e padrões BIM nacionais e internacionais (incluindo ISO 19650).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e comunicação com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com integração BIM em plataformas de gestão documental (Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint).
  • Conhecimento em programação visual (Dynamo, Grasshopper) e/ou linguagens de script aplicadas ao BIM.
  • Certificações em BIM Management.
  • Espanhol técnico.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Liderança e habilidade de gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Organização, proatividade e foco em resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação.
  • Visão estratégica para evolução dos proc

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package. Please note only referred candidates will be contacted. All applications MUST be submitted in ENGLISH.

Position Description

We are seeking a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Engineer to join its Inspection Technology Unit (ITU) within the Inspection Technical Support Division.

The ITU is responsible for the development and deployment of advanced inspection technologies to ensure asset integrity across upstream and downstream operations. The unit focuses on qualifying and implementing innovative solutions—particularly In-Line Inspection (ILI) systems—to improve pipeline safety, reliability, and cost efficiency.

As a Non-Destructive Testing Engineer, your primary role is to lead the evaluation and implementation of NDT technologies, especially ILI systems, to enhance pipeline integrity strategies.

Duties and Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Evaluate emerging NDT and ILI technologies
  • Provide technical guidance on application, and support their deployment across pipeline operations.
  • Oversee the technical performance of ILI tools in the field
  • Collaborate with vendors to improve data quality and tool capabilities
  • Assist in validating inspection results through field verification and integration with inspection programs.
  • Promote the adoption of advanced inspection methodologies to detect and manage critical pipeline anomalies such as corrosion, cracking, and geometry defects, ensuring alignment with safety, compliance, and operational excellence standards.

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Advance degree is highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in asset inspection and non-destructive testing technologies, including hands-on involvement in inline inspection operations and data interpretation.
  • NDT Level III certification in at least two inspection methods.
  • Ability to apply international codes and standards relevant to inspection operations, such as API, ASME, and AWS.
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong understanding of pipeline inspection principles, including pigging operations, pipeline cleaning, and inline inspection tool validation techniques.
  • Experience identifying and analyzing damage mechanisms detected via inline inspection, such as corrosion, stress corrosion cracking, weld anomalies, dents, and cracks.
  • Familiar with high-resolution inspection technologies used in inline tools, including magnetic flux leakage, ultrasonic testing, and electromagnetic acoustic transducer systems.
  • Capability to analyze inline inspection results and provide technical support for run/rerun decisions, dig verification campaigns, and fitness-for-service assessments.
  • Knowledge of AI and machine learning integration for predictive pipeline integrity assessments is preferred.
  • Proficiency in interpreting inspection data using advanced analytics software.
  • Ability demonstrates strong economic analysis, planning, and budgeting skills to support inspection strategy development and implementation.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development. We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Job Description

The Managing Principal Engineer (MPE) for Ship and Statutory Department is a strategic position for the ABS Rio de Janeiro Engineering Department. As ABS continues to expand its services and deliverables, this leadership role strengthens client engagement, enhances technical oversight, and streamlines departmental operations.

Responsibilities
  • Functions under the direction and oversight of a more senior Department Engineering Manager, directs and monitors project work within a technical area of a larger engineering department, and holds full responsibility for outcomes in that area.
  • Leads in their area of specialization and assigns work according to priority.
  • Acts as a technical resource and mentor to principal, senior and entry to mid-level engineers in the area of responsibility.
  • Maintains day-to-day activities, including the quality, content, consistency and continuity of all technical work performed in an assigned technical unit or area.
What You Will Do
  • Responsible for the technical verification of tasks related to ship/statutory disciplines and training new engineers in these areas.
  • Assists in the development of short- and long-range business plans and related annual operating and capital expense budgets.
  • Maintains active awareness of business and management developments affecting present and potential customers.
  • Maintains awareness of product and service capabilities of the business. Identifies improvement and developmental needs, takes action to capitalize on prospective market opportunities and makes recommendations for technology or technical tools and manpower skills necessary to implement new and improved products and services.
  • Ensures that assigned engineering positions are adequately staffed with qualified and competent personnel capable of carrying out assigned technical projects in accordance with established policies, procedures and technical standards.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements are fulfilled with regard to project work within a technical unit or area.
  • Monitors the delivery and quality of technical services to customer satisfaction.
  • Prepares annual performance appraisals. Evaluates and communicates individual performance issues with staff under direct supervision, and recommends compensation adjustments and advancements to senior management.
  • Identifies training needs and determines appropriate training programs for developing subordinate and engineering staff members.
  • Plans and monitors ABS mandatory, required and other training needs of subordinate staff members.
  • May serve as account manager on technical projects for designated customers and actively promotes the services of ABS to clients.
  • May serve on technical or industry committees and may represent the company as a spokesperson at industry conferences or meetings.
Education and Experience
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Proficiency in English commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services; ability to communicate effectively with both laymen and experts.
  • Technical background on designing and/or reviewing different types of ships.
For those with Hull backgrounds
  • B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Exposure to the Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research).
For those with Machinery backgrounds
  • B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Graduate from university with a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Experience in the design and review of ship structures for offshore support vessels, tugs, pushers, and barges for rivers, intracoastal, and oceangoing services; familiarity with large merchant vessels is an asset.
  • Proficiency in conducting intact and damage stability analyses for ships and offshore structures, including freeboard calculations, verification of loading manuals, and related documentation.

Knowledge of safety arrangements requirements for ships and offshore structures based on applicable International Conventions and Regulations for a broad range of ships and floating units, including Brazilian-flagged vessels, including but not limited to Stability, Load Line, Tonnage, SOLAS, MARPOL, IBWMC, MLC, NORMAMs, etc.

The incumbent reports directly to a Senior Managing Principal Engineer or higher. Direct reports include engineering or technical staff and office support staff of the assigned technical unit or area.

You'll be

What you'll get in return

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company. As a part of our team, you will combine software development skills with software and infrastructure delivery experience.

  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry role at Nexer Telescope .

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope\'s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Required competence
  • At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a \'no\' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.
Extent & Duration
  • Start ASAP.
  • Full time.
  • Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur.
  • Minimum 12 months.
  • Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday.
  • Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.
Location

You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.

Remuneration

Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

This is a unique opportunity to use your software engineering and cryptography skills to build and maintain the security foundation that enables Ubuntu and its users to operate securely and remain compliant to international information security standards such as FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria. As a member of the Security Hardening team you will work with and develop automation tooling to audit deployed systems for DISA-STIG and CIS benchmark compliance. You will interact with internal and external stakeholders to identify gaps in our frameworks, and develop new solutions to address these challenges. In this role you will have the opportunity to influence team and security culture, facilitate technical delivery, and help drive team direction and execution. You'll collaborate closely with Canonical's kernel team as well as the wider engineering organization to drive features impacting all Ubuntu users.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components (OpenSSL, Libgcrypt, GnuTLS, and others) with the features and functionality required for FIPS and CC certification
  • Collaborate with external security consultants to test and validate kernel and crypto module components
  • Work with external partners to develop security hardening benchmarks and audit + remediation automation for Ubuntu
  • Contribute to Ubuntu mainline and upstream projects to land solutions and benefit the community
  • Communication and collaboration within and outside Canonical to identify opportunities to improve our security posture, rapidly resolve issues, and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals, including prior experience with C development, and the ability to demonstrate such
  • Hands-on experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security and cryptography fundamentals + direct experience writing secure code and implementing best practices
  • Significant development experience working with open source libraries
  • Excellent verbal and written communications to enable efficient collaboration with internal and external partners in a remote-first environment

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Prior experience working directly with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)

title: Training Site Infrastructure Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

Key responsibilities
  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

Your profile

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

O Gerente de Vendas será responsável por liderar a equipe comercial , definir estratégias agressivas de crescimento e garantir resultados consistentes em margem e receita . Seu papel é construir autoridade no mercado , dominar a concorrência e transformar previsões em números reais de faturamento.

  • Usar técnicas avançadas de negociação: perguntas estratégicas, “ponte ao futuro” e quebra de objeções .

  • Atingimento e superação de metas mensais e trimestrais.

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes comerciais e vendas de alto valor.

  • Foco em lucro, margem e posicionamento de mercado .
Diferenciais
  • Histórico de crescimento acelerado em empresas B2B ou B2C.

  • Capacidade de transformar objeções em novas oportunidades de fechamento .
Remuneração & Benefícios

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.

  • You are a lifelong learner

description:
About the Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 09

About the role

The Team: This position is for the Americas Gas team, with team members in Canada, the United States, Mexico, and Brazil. We are part of the Research and Analytics Solutions business line that includes analysts from Upstream, Oil, Fuel and Chemicals, Gas and LNG, Power and Renewables, Agriculture and Metals, and Shipping.

Responsibilities and Impact

The focus of this position is on gas markets across Latin American and Caribbean gas markets, to provide quantitative and qualitative research, create regular and stand-alone reports, and support local events for a wide client base from across the energy value chain.

Responsibilities include:

  • Evaluate, model, and analyze natural gas market fundamentals including supply, demand, prices, transportation of natural gas and low carbon gases in region of focus.
  • Articulate insights that affect the gas markets in region of focus through written regular reports, emails, webinars, briefings and in-person or virtual presentations to customers
  • Collect information, maintain databases and in-house models in a time-effective way.
  • Contribute to standalone projects as required and as driven by business needs.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with clients to understand their needs in addition to ensuring they know the capabilities of S&P Global Commodity Insights.
What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Fluency in English and the ability to communicate in Spanish and/or Portuguese.
  • A bachelor’s degree, preferably Engineering or Economics, or equivalent experience.
  • Comfortable with Generative AI technologies and able to leverage these tools for innovative solutions.
  • Two to three years of working experience in areas related to the energy sector is appreciated, preferably in roles associated to operations, energy efficiency, low-carbon energy, or sustainable practices.
  • Team player with an ability to work independently with and without deadlines and prioritizing a complex workload.
  • Self-motivated and driven to develop new ideas and insights.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work autonomously.
  • Ability to work well in a team-oriented environment providing ideas and open feedback.
  • Comfortable with client presentations.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proactive, able to learn quickly, multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Significant comfort level with suite of Microsoft Office products (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint Excel, Power BI).
  • Experience with Python, SQL.

About S&P Global Commodity Insights

At S&P Global Commodity Insights, our complete view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make decisions with conviction and create long-term, sustainable value.

We’re a trusted connector that brings together thought leaders, market participants, governments, and regulators to co-create solutions that lead to progress. Vital to navigating Energy Transition, S&P Global Commodity Insights’ coverage includes oil and gas, power, chemicals, metals, agriculture and shipping.

S&P Global Commodity Insights is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit: spglobal.com/commodity-insights

What’s In It For You?

Our Purpose: Progress is not a self-starter. It requires a catalyst to be set in motion. Information, imagination, people, technology—the right combination can unlock possibility and change the world.

Our world is in transition and getting more complex by the day. We push past expected observations and seek out new levels of understanding so that we can help companies, governments and individuals make an impact on tomorrow. At S&P Global we transform data into Essential Intelligence, pinpointing risks and opening possibilities. We Accelerate Progress.

Our People: We’re more than 35,000 strong worldwide—driving curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.

Our Values: Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Quem é Stone Tech? A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Quem é Stone Tech? A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil. Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa Cultura Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Sênior Data Scientist

Apoiar decisões estratégicas de negócio através de experimentos com rigor estatístico , tanto no online quanto no offline (agentes comerciais, polos, canais).

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e executar A/B tests, multivariados e quasi-experimentos;
  • Criar metodologias robustas para experimentos offline (polos comerciais);
  • Desenvolver frameworks para simulação e análise de poder estatístico;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com PMs e engenheiros na evolução da plataforma de experimentação;
  • Garantir comunicação clara dos resultados para stakeholders executivos.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Forte background em estatística e design de experimentos (DOE, causal inference);
  • Experiência prática com A/B testing e experimentos em larga escala;
  • Fluência em Python ou R para análise estatística;
  • Vivência em ferramentas de experimentação (Amplitude, Growthbook, VWO);
  • Capacidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em impacto de negócio;

O Que Aumenta Suas Chances

  • Experiência em experimentação offline;
  • Experiência em modelos quasi-experimentais (dif-in-dif, propensity score matching).

Nossos Benefícios

O titular do cargo atua em um ambiente multidisciplinar de contratos e compras (exploração, perfuração, desenvolvimento, trabalho no mar e em terra) em um ambiente internacional e ambiente de conteúdo local simultaneamente.

A falta ou entrega tardia de materiais ou serviços, independentemente de seu valor, pode ter consequências importantes na produção e nas finanças.

Atividades

O(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da Empresa, bem como sua reputação.

As principais atividades do titular do cargo são:

  • Supervisionar o estabelecimento dos contratos, participando diretamente dos contratos e pedidos de compra mais complexos.
  • Validar ou garantir a validação de todos os documentos contratuais e cartas formais emitidas pela área de contratos e compras.
  • Participar de auditorias contratuais seletivas para garantir o cumprimento dos termos e condições contratuais.
  • Intervir na resolução de litígios, em conjunto com as áreas Jurídica, Seguros e Financeira, propondo estratégias e ações, e participando das negociações.
  • Definir e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para garantir a melhoria da eficiência.
  • Manter atualizados os conteúdos locais dos modelos de contrato (condições gerais e particulares), e adaptar versões internacionais às exigências locais.
  • Garantir o reporte global da equipe de Contratos e Compras à gestão da SCLC.
  • Definir, adotar e monitorar estratégias de contratação e compras adequadas (por categorias, etc.).
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, sendo responsável por garantir o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas e boas práticas, não apenas com a SCLC, mas também com outras áreas da Empresa.
  • Realizar todas as atividades de contratação em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empresa e com a legislação brasileira.
  • Definir a estratégia de contratação em conjunto com o(a) contraparte do “Dueto” para atender e proteger os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa.
  • Propor, pré-qualificar e recomendar contratantes/fornecedores adequados para listas de licitação, visando maximizar a eficiência dos processos de concorrência.
  • Compilar, emitir e administrar pacotes de “Convite para Licitação” para obter propostas realistas e comercialmente atrativas de potenciais contratantes/fornecedores. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).
  • Redigir termos e condições contratuais e comerciais apropriados para melhor atender e proteger os interesses da Empresa.
  • Revisar propostas, participar de esclarecimentos e negociações contratuais e comerciais, preparar todos os documentos associados, como apresentações, atas de reuniões, registro de qualificações contratuais e comerciais, minuta de recomendação de adjudicação, finalizar o contrato, administrar a adjudicação de contratos, ordens de mudança/variação, aditivos contratuais, reivindicações e toda a correspondência associada.
  • Revisar e considerar os aspectos legais associados à adjudicação e administração de contratos, em articulação com o Departamento Jurídico, fornecendo aconselhamento aos clientes conforme apropriado e auxiliando, quando necessário, na resolução de litígios.
  • Arquivar a documentação contratual e correspondências de forma lógica, organizada e auditável.
  • Participar da aprovação externa (Parceiros), revisando os boletins com as informações relevantes de C&P.
  • Garantir que todos os certificados contratuais, garantias, cauções e seguros exigidos no portfólio de contratos estejam em vigor dentro do prazo.
  • Facilitar reuniões necessárias para a condução das atividades do cargo.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Ativos Operados por Terceiros (OBO), participando de apresentações do Operador e assessorando nos aspectos contratuais e comerciais.

O titular do cargo gerencia a Conformidade:

  • Verificar que as Políticas de Contratos e Compras da empresa e as leis e regulamentos aplicáveis estão sendo seguidos, especialmente no que diz respeito à ética e transparência.
  • Verificar que os documentos e procedimentos de compras estão em conformidade com os padrões da empresa e com os acordos firmados com os parceiros.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o respeito aos procedimentos durante o processo de licitação.
  • Assegurar a aplicação das Condições Gerais de Compra da TEPBR, especialmente no que diz respeito a equipamentos complexos, de alto valor e alto risco.

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Servir como exemplo pessoal na adesão aos procedimentos de HSE da TEPBR.
  • Promover conscientização e fornecer orientação aos colaboradores sob sua supervisão quanto à execução das regras de HSE, tanto para funcionários da Empresa quanto para fornecedores, sem prejudicar as obrigações legais do Contratado.
  • Assegurar, para si e para os colaboradores sob sua supervisão, a segurança do ambiente de trabalho, evitando riscos às pessoas, às instalações e impactos ao meio ambiente.
  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares e reportar quaisquer incidentes (anomalias, atos inseguros, quase acidentes, danos, derramamentos, lesões, etc.).
  • Notificar os colaboradores relevantes sobre acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes, e iniciar ações corretivas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar, negociar, adjudicar e administrar contratos/pedidos de compra de obras, bens e serviços de forma a garantir que os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa sejam atendidos e protegidos.
  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.
  • Os indicadores e KPIs sejam observados, monitorados e devidamente reportados.
  • Os objetivos de desempenho e eficiência de custos em Contratos e Compras sejam cumpridos.
  • O conhecimento técnico em Contratos e Compras seja compartilhado dentro do grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
Perfil do Candidato

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

Qualificação e Experiência:

  • Formação superior (nível universitário ou acima).
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos processos de compras, incluindo: princípios éticos; pré-qualificação de licitantes; convite para licitação; avaliação comparativa de contratantes; adjudicação, gestão de reivindicações, administração, alteração e encerramento de contratos.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.
  • Conhecimento geral e compreensão das funções empresariais da empresa, com entendimento aprofundado da função de contratos e de como ela agrega valor, além de compromisso em entregar valor agregado.
  • Deve ter proficiência em inglês e fluência em português.

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.

A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.

Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Vessel Medic role at McDermott International, Ltd

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

Job Description

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy’s future, and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform initial diagnoses and treatments, stabilizing patients until they can be transferred to medical facilities on land, if necessary
  • Implement disease prevention and health promotion programs
  • Monitor and control outbreaks of infectious diseases on board
  • Manage the stock of medicines and medical equipment, ensuring that they are always available and in good condition
  • Keep detailed records of all care and procedures performed
  • Train staff on first aid procedures and use of emergency equipment
  • Conduct educational sessions on occupational health and safety
  • Work with safety engineers, occupational safety technicians and other professionals to ensure a safe work environment
  • Participate in occupational health and safety meetings
  • Ensure that all medical activities comply with regulatory standards, such as NR-30 and NR-37
  • Provide ongoing guidance and training to the Nurse on medical and emergency procedures
  • In emergency situations, the Doctor makes critical decisions and guides the Nurse in carrying out the necessary procedures

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Doctor Degree in Medicine and registration with the Regional Medical Council (CRM).
  • Certifications in advanced life support, such as Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS)
  • Advanced English CBSP and HUET NR 32 and NR 37
  • Minimum experience of 02 years in Emergency Medicine or Intensive Care

Preferred Qualifications and Education:

  • Desirable offshore experience

About Us

title: MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA - CEEDI AP 3.3
description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Registro de especialista em Psiquiatria (RQE)
  • Desejável pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Mental; TEA; Saúde da Família; Saúde Pública; Saúde Coletiva
  • Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Desejável experiência com TEA (Transtorno do Espectro Autista na infância e adolescência)
Additional information
  • Carga Horária: 40h/20h semanais
  • Local de atuação: AP 3.3 (Madureira e Adjacências)

Descrição da empresa

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO ?

Somos a Doctoralia , empresa do grupo Docplanner , e estamos presentes em 13 países , sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!
Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.

Nossa missão é “Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis”.

Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos : marketplace , que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório , fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online . Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos contratando um Líder de Onboarding para liderar e otimizar os primeiros 45 dias da jornada dos nossos clientes (clínicas com 1 ou 2 usuários). Você será responsável por um time focado em impulsionar a ativação, adoção e tempo até o valor percebido — garantindo que essas clínicas implementem com sucesso o sistema da Feegow, compreendam suas funcionalidades principais e se mantenham engajadas nas primeiras semanas críticas de adoção.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Liderar o time de onboarding responsável pelas clínicas pequenas, garantindo um processo estruturado, próximo e escalável.
  • Ser dono dos principais indicadores da área: ativação, adoção, churn precoce e tempo até o primeiro valor.
  • Definir, documentar e iterar o playbook de onboarding para esse segmento.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar treinamentos de produto para elevar o conhecimento técnico do time.
  • Colaborar com os times de Produto, Suporte e Expansão para identificar fricções e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Atuar como liderança prática: apoiar o time em onboardings complexos quando necessário.
Qualificações
  • Experiência em Onboarding ou Implementação em empresas SaaS
  • Experiência em liderança ou coordenação com gestão de pessoas
  • Vivência com gestão de KPIs e funis de onboarding: SLA, Scorings, Early Churn
  • Capacidade de desenhar processos e especialmente seguir processos
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM: Hubspot ou Salesforce
  • Inglês - Médio a avancado
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido em Curitiba ou Rio de Janeiro
Informações adicionais

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.

  • Jornada de trabalho é de segunda à sexta, das 9h às 18h;
  • Modelo híbrido: 2 vezes por semana no escritório em Curitiba ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Banco de horas como folga, posteriormente;

You are passionate about performance excellence and able to analyse and form clear, coherent conclusions from a variety of data and information. You find it easy communicating complex or technical information and delivering messages that are easily understood.You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment and proven track record of fostering strong working relationships through coaching, influencing and developing others around you. You understand that diversity of experience and thought is important and that working across different geographies requires cultural appreciation.If you are looking for a role where you can be part of a dynamic team, that is supporting clients to make better informed decisions, and influence how we power our planet, apply now**.****Qualifications and Capabilities*** Minimum of a BSc in a Geoscience discipline; a data science qualification would be an advantage.* 5-10 years of Subsurface experience within the Upstream sector with a strong understanding of the petroleum geology of the Americas and deep exposure to common Subsurface use cases, workflows and data usage.* Demonstrable data analytical skills and experience of working with databases.* Up-to-date knowledge of the utilisation of AI across the Upstream Subsurface space.* Experience in external relationship building and management.* Strong commercial acumen.* Demonstrable curiosity with a track record of impactful innovation.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.* A track record in demonstrating differentiated values and behaviours with a particular focus on teamwork and collaboration.**Expectations*** We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be required to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment.
